verdicts.reason: The two are almost identical. In both, the top-left mark is blown up far beyond its size in the original, the photo bleeds off the left edge but stops short on the right and leaves a dead strip, and the G.M. ALLEN box is indented away from the quote's left edge, with its text sitting off-centre inside the box. B gets the edge because its small bottom mark lines up with the left edge of the author box, while A's is a few pixels off. A also crowds the quote right up under the photo.
